query:
SELECT
              split_part(split_part(inbox_url, '/', 3), ':', 1) AS "host!",
              count(*) AS "jobs!",
              max(attempts) AS "max_attempts!",
              EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM min(run_at) - now())::float8 AS "next_due_seconds"
           FROM delivery_jobs
           GROUP BY 1
           ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1
           LIMIT $1
